The plot illustrates the smoothed training and validation loss over a sequence of steps. The x-axis is labeled "Step" and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140 with regularly spaced tick labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 2.5. A blue solid line indicates the smoothed training loss per batch, starting at approximately 2.0 at Step 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.3 at Step 140; it exhibits fluctuations with a peak of 2.14 at Step 2 and a minimum of 0.2 at Step 140. An orange solid line represents the validation loss, beginning at approximately 1.5 at Step 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.3 at Step 140; it shows fluctuations over the range, reaching a maximum value of 1.84 at Step 2 and a minimum of 0.24 at Step 140.
